question:
Find the value of: 

(0.63 ÷ 1.26) × 4 + 5 × 3
solution:
Given:

(0.63 ÷ 1.26) × 4 + 5 × 3

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc39efa9ed4f0e8f3a13804d9cd35a57480c17ba618ddcb102c34a0474acd66.png] 

Calculation:

(0.63 ÷ 1.26) × 4 + 5 × 3

⇒ 0.5 × 4 + 5 × 3

⇒ 2 + 15

⇒ 17

∴ The simplified value is 17.
